facts.statement: Placochelys fossils date to the Late Triassic, specifically from the Norian to Rhaetian stages.
Placochelys lived between 221.5 and 205.6 million years ago during the Triassic period.
facts.quote: Fossils of Placochelys dates back to the Triassic period (age range: 221.5 to 205.6 million years ago).

facts.statement: Fossils of Placochelys have been found in Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Italy.
facts.quote: They have been found in Germany, Austria, Hungary and Italy.

facts.statement: Placochelys resembled a sea turtle and reached a length of about 90 cm.
facts.quote: Placochelys looked remarkably similar to a sea turtle, and grew to about 90 cm in length.

facts.statement: Placochelys had a flat, turtle-like shell covered in knobby plates and a compact triangular skull.
facts.quote: It had a flat turtle-like carapace covered with knobbly plates, and a compact triangular skull.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest the specialized broad teeth on Placochelys's palate were used for crushing shellfish and hard-shelled prey.
facts.quote: The specialized broad teeth on the palate, were most likely used for crushing shellfish and hard-shelled prey.

facts.statement: Placochelys had paddle-shaped limbs for swimming with discernable toes and a short tail, unlike modern sea turtles.
facts.quote: Its limbs were paddle-shaped for swimming, although, unlike modern sea turtles, they still had discernable toes, and it also had a short tail.

facts.statement: Placochelys belongs to the superorder Sauropterygia, order Placodontia, and family Placochelyidae.
facts.quote: superordo: Sauropterygia ordo: Placodontia familia: Placochelyidae genus: Placochelys

facts.statement: Placochelys was notably similar to a sea turtle and could reach 1 meter in length.
facts.quote: Placochelys era notablemente similar a una tortuga marina, alcanzaban 1 m (3 pies) de longitud.

facts.statement: Placochelys lived in the Middle and Late Triassic in what is now Germany.
facts.quote: que vivió en el Triásico medio y el Triásico superior, en lo que hoy es Alemania.

facts.statement: The parent group of Placochelys is Placochelyida, and it is classified as a reptile.
The Paleobiology Database lists the time range for Placochelys as Carnian to Campanian (237 to 72.2 million years ago).
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Campanian (237 to 72.2 million years ago)
